missing: Measured real-world results: actual scrub/playback behaviour in Premiere and Resolve for specific codecs (ProRes 422 HQ, BRAW, H.265 4K) on named NAS models over 10GbE versus a direct Thunderbolt link, with current prices for the NAS plus the drives, NIC and switch needed to reach that speed.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. The field is three niche sites (The Post Flow, WunderTech, TerabyteWise) that give direct picks and spec comparisons but no checkable testing, two maker pages (QNAP, UGREEN), and seven affiliate or recycled-domain listicles, several of which claim testing they cannot show. A focused page comparing current 10GbE and Thunderbolt NAS models on sustained throughput, codec bitrate coverage, total system cost and current prices with a direct pick for solo versus team editors would stand out.
